newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta Treasurer Dinning won't seek re-election.
newsitem.headline: Alberta Treasurer Dinning won't seek re-election.

text.p: Alberta Treasurer Jim Dinning, known as the architect of his oil-rich western province's economic recovery, said on Thursday he would not seek re-election when the government's current term ends.
"Today, I am announcing this will be my last season as a politician," Dinning said in a speech to the Calgary Chamber of Commerce.
The Conservative government of Premier Ralph Klein is widely expected to call an election before next spring.
